title: R56: attention/shared-expert projection fusion A/B on RTX 5090 (b=16)
config: d12 seq=1024, R50-best fused paths + graph replay + AdamW outside graph

fusions.attn_proj: Attention.forward: cat(wq_a, wkv) -> one GEMM; cat-backward also fuses dX and dW
fusions.shared_expert: shared Expert: cat(w1, w3) -> one GEMM (SwiGLU unchanged)

notes: Fusion is not bitwise identical to the two-GEMM path (cuBLAS tiling for N=160/768 vs N=96/64/384 changes fp32 accumulation order): step-1 loss rel diff 7.1e-5 for both fusions.
Default stays OFF (parity-preserving); env-gated: NANOV41_ATTN_PROJ_FUSED=1, NANOV41_SHARED_EXPERT_FUSED=1.
Individually the fusions were flat (59.34 / 59.47) but the combination is consistently -0.39 ms; keep the two knobs together when using it.
